description: This file defines a React functional component 'NotesApp' that manages state and renders 'NoteList' and 'NoteDetails' components for a simple notes application.

methods.name: NotesApp
methods.description: React functional component managing the notes application's main state.

methods.name: handleCreate
methods.description: Sets the selected note ID to create a new note.

methods.name: handleDelete
methods.description: Deletes the selected note and triggers a refresh.

methods.name: handleCreated
methods.description: Sets the selected note to the newly created note and refreshes.

methods.name: handleUpdated
methods.description: Triggers a refresh after an update.
